caption: A pair of glasses is brought in from the cold street into a warm café, and the lenses fog over.

sa.check: The glasses are brought in from outside into a warm room.
The lenses are clear while still outside.
The fogging comes after the glasses are inside.

pc.expect: The fog appears once the glasses are inside and then holds or clears; it does not appear while they are still out in the cold.
pc.fail: The lenses are fogged while still outside in the cold; or the fog appears, clears and appears again with the glasses held still indoors; or the fog thickens after the lenses have cleared; or the fog appears before the glasses have moved.

pc.expect: The change is a haze on the lenses themselves: what lies behind them blurs where the haze is and comes back as it clears.
pc.fail: The frames change colour rather than the lenses; or the haze lies on the frame and not on the glass; or the view behind the lenses changes to a different scene as the fog clears; or the lenses turn a colour instead of hazing.

pc.expect: Droplets that gather run downward on the lens and any drip falls away.
pc.fail: A droplet runs up the lens; or a drip leaves the lens and rises; or water gathers along the lens's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: The fog lies on the glass surface and nothing else appears or vanishes behind it.
pc.fail: Objects seen through the fogged lens are missing when it clears; or new objects appear behind the fog; or the fog detaches from the lens and drifts as a cloud; or the lens vanishes behind the fog.

pc.expect: One pair of glasses with two lenses in one frame; the frame keeps its shape and nothing passes through the lenses.
pc.fail: A lens vanishes; or a third lens appears; or a hand passes through a lens; or the frame bends into another shape.

pc.expect: The frames, the room behind and the clothing stay the same.
pc.fail: The frames change colour; or the room's furniture rearranges; or the clothing changes.

note: The glasses may be on a face or in a hand; the person is not judged.
